checks.rationale: tools/list requires OAuth and the vendor publishes no public machine-readable inventory. Review the union of Scalekit's 14 read-only tools and Claude's directory task tools. The official help describes read-only access while the directory lists add_task and update_task; retain write and destructive verdicts if those tools appear. No credentials, authenticated catalog or operational tool calls were used.

evidence.notes: Credential-free curl verified a 401 Bearer resource_metadata challenge with openid offline_access, the exact protected resource, header-only bearer support, dynamic registration, CIMD and PKCE S256. Public setup now permits email/password sign-in when the login page returns to authorization; sign-in alone does not complete setup. Classification is a reviewed superset, not a claim that every account exposes all 18 names. No schema digests are asserted without reviewed schemas.
